system.description: At the end of a mission during which you planted or hid evidence to shift blame away from you and your team, name who you threw under the corporate bus and roll Edge.

success.value: the MC will not increase Corporate Clocks in the retaliation phase, and the MC will reduce a Corporate Clock by one

partial.value: the MC will not increase Corporate Clocks in the retaliation phase

failure.value: create or increase the Threat Clock of whoever you threw under the bus
